objects.name: Splunk security advisory (AV26-586)
objects.description: Serial number: AV26-586 Date: June 10, 2026 On June 10, 2026, Splunk published security advisories to address vulnerabilities in the following products: Splunk SOAR – versions prior to 8.5.0 Splunk Enterprise – multiple versions and platforms Splunk Cloud Platform – multiple versions and platforms The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply the necessary updates.
